MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 27
   C. 31
   D. 25

2. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 26

5. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

7. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 14
   C. 6
   D. 9

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 65

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. C — 16
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4
3. Product = 16
Final Answer: 16
